name: Blasted Lands: the Nethergarde Foreman Chest stands on the Nethergarde mine camp floor (#12085)
contract: Worldforged pickup 96192 'Nethergarde Crate' (guid 6940802, loot 515283) was imported at (-10834.1, -3050.0) with the realm dump's own height 57.282. rev_20261006_65_worldforged_openworld_float_heights.sql lowered it to the terrain height 53.7997, but the spot lies on the floor of the Nethergarde goldmine WMO (Md_Goldmine_Variantd.wmo, tile 000_37_52), whose one surface at that X/Y is at z 57.28. The chest sat 3.48 yd under that floor where players could not see or reach it. It now stands back on the floor: the distance to the realm-dump position is the discriminating check (3.48 before), and open sky above the chest means it is no longer under the floor (about 3.2 yd of headroom before).
